subtitle: A shared in-game settings menu for BepInEx mods.
description: Adds a Mods section to the native Stranded Deep settings UI and lets other mods register user-facing options in one consistent interface.
features: Integrates into the native Stranded Deep settings screen as a Mods section.
Supports four control types: Slider, Toggle, Choice and Button.
Each client mod remains the owner of its ConfigEntry values, state and validation.
Mod Settings owns the registry, renderer and UI, not another mod's data.
The client SDK uses a soft dependency and reflection bridge through the BepInEx Chainloader.
A correctly integrated client mod can keep its core functionality when Mod Settings is absent.
Mod sections can define stable IDs, display names and ordering.
UI Scaler already uses the shared menu for its interface scale control.

faq.question: Does Mod Settings own other mods' configuration values?
faq.answer: No. The client mod remains the source of truth and exposes getters and setters to the UI host.

faq.question: Do client mods need a hard dependency?
faq.answer: No. The intended integration uses a soft dependency and the SDK bridge.

faq.question: Does every mod need to build its own Unity settings UI?
faq.answer: Not for normal user-facing settings. The host renders registered controls in a shared native-style menu.

faq.question: Is there a field-tested integration?
faq.answer: Yes. UI Scaler uses Mod Settings for its interface scale setting.
